name: Service Electric Cable TV & Communications - Bethlehem HQ
old_description: An affordable alternative to traditional cable television at only $19.95 per month with hundreds of live bonus channels and NO network fees, cable TV fees, sports channel fees or rental fees!  Bonus channels include more than 70 Spanish language channels, 40+ true crime options, music, news, weather, kids channels and much more!
about:
Service Electric Cable TV & Communications is headquartered in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, where it consolidated operations in 2014. The company traces its origins to 1948, when founder John Walson Sr. (born John Walsonavich) extended a coaxial cable from an antenna atop Broad Mountain to his appliance store in Mahanoy City, creating the first community antenna television system in the United States. Now a third-generation family business, it remains under the leadership of the Walson family, with John M. Walson serving as president since 2012.

The company provides cable television, broadband internet, and telephone services across the Lehigh Valley, Hunterdon County (NJ), and Wilkes-Barre regions. Residential offerings include a low-cost Broadband TV package with hundreds of channels and no hidden fees, plus Gig+ internet speeds paired with eero whole-home WiFi. For commercial customers, Service Electric Business delivers dedicated internet, voice, and cable TV with free local, same-day service calls. The firm also operates the Service Electric Network (SEN), a three-channel local network producing high school and collegiate sports, community events, and festival coverage.

Customers range from individual households to small, medium, and enterprise-level businesses throughout eastern Pennsylvania and western New Jersey. Partnerships with PenTeleData and Alianza extend internet and voice capabilities, while membership in the America's Communications Association and the Broadband Communications Association of Pennsylvania underscores industry engagement.

Service Electric emphasizes its deep community roots and pioneering history—it was the first U.S. cable system to offer Home Box Office in 1972 and among the earliest to deploy two-way cable modems. The company cites its family ownership, local workforce, and commitment to same-day business support as key differentiators in a market dominated by national providers.
